name: Booking Calendar — Availability Rules
description: One doc per (userId, meetingType) — each one is a meeting type, booked at /meet/<meetingType>.

name.description: { es, en } — what people see, emojis allowed

priceCents.description: 0 = free. Server-side price, never taken from the client

active.description: Off = hidden from the public list and not bookable

showDuration.description: Show the duration on the public page

questions.description: Asked when booking, besides name/email/subject/WhatsApp: [{ key, label: {es,en}, type: text|textarea|select|url, options: [{es,en}], required }]

timezone.description: IANA timezone — rules are expressed in this zone

read.description: Public read is required so getAvailableSlots can compute for anonymous guests
